original.friction_turn: Run heavy, the ground floods: roots soaked past drinking, growth postponed for one more season of preparation. Drain a little. Trees also need sun.

friction.clause: The ground floods: roots soaked past drinking, growth postponed for one more season of preparation.

thin.clause: Water runs thin and unwanted: a little rain, quickly used.

excess.clause: Too much water floats the wood: roots off the ground, drifting from plan to plan, nothing anchored.
excess.remedy: Drain it. Plant one thing and stay.

repFields.function.definition_catalyst: Water is your Mind, and as a catalyst, it is how you refill: quiet intake, reading, long conversations, time alone that lets impressions settle into understanding. Your thinking improves in direct proportion to your rest.
repFields.function.definition_friction: Water is your Mind, and as a friction, it is intake past the point of use: one more book, one more opinion, reflection turning into stalling. More input now costs you clarity instead of adding it.
repFields.function.advise_catalyst: Understanding arrives on its own schedule and only through an open door. Hold one screen-free hour before bed. Take the walk before the decision. Keep a note of what surfaces there, because it will be the truest thinking you do.
repFields.function.advise_friction: A mind can also overwater. Close the intake and let what you know settle: set a decision date and honor it, act on the last book before opening the next, and take one full day a week with nothing new coming in.
repFields.mechanism.base: Water gives life to wood, the old texts say, because it moistens: rain soaks the ground, the root drinks in the dark, and what was a seed unfolds toward the sky. The forest is not raised by effort. It is raised by weather, by the patient water that asks no credit for the green it lifts.
repFields.mechanism.catalyst_turn: Run thin, the canopy outpaces the rain: ambition still reaching while the soil dries. Your chart asks you to feed the water table. Rest, read, go quiet and refill.
repFields.cta_verdict: Your thinking absorbs like rain into roots, slow and total, and what you learn deeply once feeds you for decades.
repFields.carry.catalyst: The canopy outpaces the rain: ambition still reaching while the soil dries. Rest, read, go quiet and refill.
repFields.carry.wide: Water is already here in plenty, the rain the whole tree drinks from. Stop refilling. Grow something from what you already know.
repFields.carry.missing: No water at the root: reaching on dry ground, nothing taken in before it is spent. Borrow water: rest, reading, one quiet hour.
repFields.carry.spared: Water runs absent, and the ground stays firm: nothing floods, nothing waits on one more season. Keep it dry. Act on what you know.
